mechanism: Hierarchical persistent memory of the user's mental state, updated by a ToM agent after each session and consulted in later sessions
evidence_scope: the ToM agent maintains an external hierarchical memory system to persist the user's state and update user models after each session (with update memory action).
evidence_role: we introduce ToM-SWE, a dual-agent architecture that pairs a primary software-engineering (SWE) agent with a lightweight theory-of-mind (ToM) partner agent dedicated to modeling the user's mental state.
